title: 高盛CEO：亚洲业务占比20%创新高，是周期高点还是结构转变？
speaker: David Solomon

segments.en: I think in terms of how much this region has contributed to your total revenue, I think it's making up 20% now which has never really happened in the history of the firm. It's at the
